test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given letter series.

DF_IJOD_HIJO_FHIJODF_IJOD_
solution:
Given series: DF_IJOD_HIJO_FHIJODF_IJOD_

Option 1) HFFDH→ DF__H__IJOD__F__HIJO__F__FHIJODF__D__IJOD__H__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) FHDHF → DF__F__IJOD__H__HIJO__D__FHIJODF__H__IJOD__F__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) HFHDF → DF__H__IJOD__F__HIJO__H__FHIJODF__D__IJOD__F__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) HFDHF → DF__**H**__IJOD__**F**__HIJO__**D**__FHIJODF__**H**__IJOD__**F**__ → (It follows the pattern of: DFHIJO - DFHIJO - DFHIJO - DFHIJO - DF)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
